feat: bind shell menus to STAC data sources and register selectShellTab (#161)

Personal center and app bar styles now render Shell Studio items through
aviary.shell.menuList instead of hardcoded Flutter menus. Swan reads platform
shell data sources from the runtime manifest, and selectShellTab is added to
the BAYA catalog so APP_BAR CLARITY imports validate. Developer settings are
reachable via a 10-tap unlock on the personal center tab within 5 seconds.
